final_candidates.decision_summary: N171Y (corresponding to N501Y in full Spike) introduces optimized aromatic stacking and hydrogen bonding with ACE2 Y41 and K353, driving strong ACE2 affinity enhancement.
Q168R (corresponding to Q498R in full Spike) forms key electrostatic contacts and salt bridges with ACE2 D38 and Q42, substantially enhancing binding affinity.
L122R (corresponding to L452R in full Spike) provides favorable electrostatic engagement with ACE2 while stabilizing the hydrophobic interface region.

stop_reason.detail: The top 3 mutations (N171Y, Q168R, L122R) are firmly established gain-of-function ACE2 binding substitutions; additional tool evaluations will not change the ranking.

history.rationale: Corresponds to N501Y, a key adaptation that significantly increases ACE2 binding affinity by optimizing contact with ACE2 K353 and Y41.
